0022600230.text: The Hornets (4-7, 1-3 on the road) visit the Phoenix Suns (3-6, 3-3 at home) for Charlotte's 12th game of the season. Charlotte sits 9th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast, 2.5 games back, after a win in its most recent game and a 3-7 record over its last ten, while Phoenix is 12th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 5.5 games back, after a loss and a 3-6 record over its last ten. Charlotte is missing Dennis Schroder (out, hamstring strain), Grant Williams (out, hamstring), Kon Knueppel (out, hamstring strain), Brandon Miller (day-to-day, groin soreness, game-time decision) and Moussa Diabate (day-to-day, quadriceps, game-time decision), while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery). The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, and they split 1-1 in 2025-26, with the Hornets winning the last meeting 127-107 in Charlotte on April 2, 2026.
